prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 5 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 5 tests.
Finish hint, adoption layout, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-in persistent pet backup showcase redesign: Redesign sign-in screen into a carousel visual format highlighting cloud pet save features to reassure users about account retention. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in redesigns have won 3 out of 5 previous tests.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive desktop widget preview sub-flow: Add an interactive desktop placement preview widget on the waiting screen so users can adjust where the pet will sit on screen before rendering finishes. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not displaying on desktop after onboarding, and home step has a median duration of 201s.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop launch guide stage redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a stage layout detailing primary mouse interactions and visibility controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is low (64.8%).)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet care profile customizer new screen: Insert a new screen (new_pet_care) during adoption where users set initial interaction frequency and roaming desktop preferences. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off during setup (68.5% conversion, median 89s), and clear preferences prevent post-onboarding confusion.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path compact carousel redesign: Redesign the path selection screen layout into a carousel format showcasing quick side-by-side previews of custom photo vs starter pet journeys. (why: Choose path has a 78.9% conversion and a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion during path selection.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Cloud recovery reassurance hint on sign-in: Add a prominent hint text on sign-in explaining that logging in links desktop pet data to cloud recovery. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets from users reporting lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.)
6: [adoption, layout] Upload photos screen split layout focus: Update upload_photos layout to a split view highlighting side-by-side photo formatting requirements. (why: Adoption conversion is 68.5% and 3 support tickets complained about custom photo pet generation failing or rendering wrong.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop display preparation wait info update: Update waiting screen status messaging to explain desktop graphics overlay initialization during pet render. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet overlay missing or failing to open, and home new flow changes have proven successful.)
8: [finish, hint] Desktop pet visibility quick tip: Display a hint on home intro clarifying how to focus or toggle desktop pet interaction mode. (why: Support received multiple reports of user confusion regarding controlling and interacting with the desktop pet after setup.)
9: [choose_path, copy] Path selection duration clarity copy update: Update choose_path screen headline and body text to clearly state the estimated creation time for each path. (why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating hesitation among users unsure of path effort.)
